project.title: Isolation and Characterisation  of Pseudomonas aeruginosa Bacteriophages
project.description: This project aims to isolate and characterize novel bacteriophages against Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Phages sourced from environmental sources will undergo comprehensive analysis, including host range determination, morphological examination via TEM, and full genome sequencing.

samples: Backwaters, effluent treatment plant, wastewater, canal water, sewage
runs: Isolation of Pseudomonas aeruginosa phage genomes from Sewage
